description: This file contains a Google Test unit test for the shared file descriptor (shared_fd) functionality, specifically testing the pipe creation and data transfer between file descriptors using the SharedFD class.

classes.name: SharedFD
classes.description: A class representing shared file descriptors, with methods for creating pipes, checking if the descriptors are open, and reading/writing data.

methods.name: SharedFD::Pipe
methods.description: Creates a pair of connected shared file descriptors for inter-process communication.

methods.name: SharedFD::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the shared file descriptor is currently open.

methods.name: SharedFD::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the shared file descriptor.

methods.name: SharedFD::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the shared file descriptor.
